daily.today_energy: Your vibe is grounded but restless—like you're ready to shake things up. Mercury's got you feeling communicative, so trust those conversations that feel important. This is your moment to speak up.
daily.love: Vulnerability is your superpower today. Whether you're single or coupled, letting someone see the real you (messy parts included) creates actual connection. Don't play it safe with your heart.
daily.career: Your ideas have weight right now. That project you've been sitting on? The energy supports you bringing it forward. Trust your instincts—they're sharper than usual.
daily.health: Your body's asking for movement and grounding. A walk outside, stretching, or something that gets you present in your physical space will shift your whole energy. Listen to what feels good.

weekly.overview: This week's energy is all about grounding yourself and getting clear on what actually matters. Venus is whispering that it's time to release what no longer serves you and lean into your natural magnetism. Trust your gut.
weekly.love: Someone's noticing your vibe, but real talk—focus on loving yourself first. If you're coupled up, this is a sweet moment to do something low-key together. No pressure, just presence.
weekly.career: Your ideas are hitting different right now. Don't dim your light in meetings; people are ready to hear what you have to say. This is your moment to advocate for yourself gently but firmly.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for slower, more intentional movement this week. Whether that's stretching, walking, or just lying in the sun, honor what feels nourishing. You've been doing a lot.
